title: Training record (untokenized)
description: One training example. `tools` and `messages` are exactly what LiteLLM sends to vLLM (captured by the scripted replay, spec 03), plus the final assistant response. Rendering to tokens uses the model's chat template (src/locfix/render/chat.py).

agent_config.description: Agent YAML the record was replayed with, e.g. agents/locfix/agent.yaml

tools.description: OpenAI tool specs exactly as sent

messages.description: OpenAI chat messages exactly as sent, ending with the trained assistant response(s)

loss.description: One entry per assistant message; messages not listed are context only.

weight.description: Record weight (EM weight w_k, anchor beta, or 1)

spans.description: Character spans inside messages for scoring y*_+ (spec 06). Each item: [message_index, field_path, start, end].

z.description: Localization used by this record (localizer/fixer records)

meta.description: Builder information: n_counted_calls, projected_seconds, compaction_window, trace_entry_ids, budget, summarizer, synthetic_steps, cleaning version, builder_version, git_sha
